storage_check.title: Check the file
storage_check.description: Check that the file holds no orphaned component row and no reference to an entity that is not there. Both are invisible to every query — a read starts from the spine — so this asks the connection directly: whether foreign keys are being enforced, which rows violate one, and what SQLite's own integrity check reports.

archetype_check.title: Check the archetype pointers
archetype_check.description: Check that every archetype pointer matches the components its owner actually has. A writer that inserts rows past the graph without naming the owners it touched leaves a stale pointer that both the read path and the query planner trust.
